Every Liberty ship was built in the Unit.why: Stated in the first sentence of Wikipedia's article and throughout writing on the American wartime home front: Liberty ships are defined as the mass-produced American emergency cargo ships. Stated directly and follows from no other fact.

sources.note: Exact phrase; sampled continuations name American yards and states.

Approximate count. Counterfactual co-occurrence: the British origin of the design (the Ocean ships ordered from American yards in 1940) is real and widely written about, which makes the counterfactual plausible.
